Otel.//: Seq ingests OTLP/HTTP protobuf directly at /ingest/otlp — the exporter appends /v1/traces, /v1/metrics itself. No signal-specific path here.

RateLimiting.//: No client sends X-Brasa-Client yet, so every dev/E2E request today shares one 'unknown' bucket per tenant — a per-client production limit would throttle the Playwright suite itself, not a real client. Effectively unconstrained here; API-12's actual behaviour is proven against a tight override in tests, not this default.
